q: The long exact sequence of a pair (X, A) in singular homology reads: … → Hₙ(A) → Hₙ(X) → Hₙ(X,A) → H_{n-1}(A) → … The connecting homomorphism ∂: Hₙ(X,A) → H_{n-1}(A) is defined by:
opts: ∂[c] = [∂c|_A] — represent a relative cycle c by its boundary (which lies in A), giving a class in H_{n-1}(A)
exp: The connecting homomorphism: given a relative cycle c ∈ Cₙ(X,A) (∂c ∈ Cₙ₋₁(A)), ∂[c] = [∂c] ∈ H_{n-1}(A). This is well-defined and gives the long exact sequence. It measures how cycles in X 'rel A' bound in A — capturing the topology of the pair.
